summary: Pickup restocks now hit hundreds of US stores a day but each lasts about two minutes, and online orders still quote late January. Locally, American Dream and Downtown Brooklyn restocked most this week, around 10am, 2pm and 4pm, so act on the alert instantly.

items.title: Late-night drops in Portland and Wisconsin on Oct 26
items.summary: Pioneer Place got several 256GB Night Sky and Star White units around 10:30 PM ET, after a 1:30 PM ET Midwest wave. No NJ or NYC store showed stock that day.

items.title: Hundreds of daily US restocks, most in mid-morning
items.summary: The tracker counted 374 store restocks on Oct 26 (707 since Oct 24). About half land between 9:40 and 11 AM store-local time, and stock usually vanishes in roughly two minutes.

items.title: Manzana: latest drop 11:35 AM ET, peaks 10 AM to 1 PM
items.summary: Its most recent US restock came at 11:35 AM ET on Oct 26; fifteen minutes later none of its 269 stores had pickup. It has logged 111 restocks since Oct 16, busiest on Sundays.

items.title: Report: Apple asks suppliers for 30% more Duos
items.summary: Taiwan's Economic Daily says Apple raised orders about 30%, lifting this year's shipment outlook to 8-10 million, though the next big shipment wave still points to around Jan 22. Not confirmed by Apple.

items.title: Assembly yields reportedly near 60%, analysts cut forecasts
items.summary: Supply-chain accounts put Foxconn's final assembly yield slightly above 60%; JPMorgan blames three-month waits partly on ramp problems. These are reports, not Apple guidance.

items.title: Pickup reservations reopened for about five minutes
items.summary: US and Canada pickup slots appeared around 8:10 AM ET on Oct 24 and disappeared roughly five minutes later; most stores never showed any.

items.title: Carriers quote December while Apple says late January
items.summary: Apple's online estimate sits near Jan 22; Verizon and AT&T promised some units around mid-December, T-Mobile late December to January. Best Buy requires a carrier-locked phone.
